<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbons, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the `carbon_nmr_spectra` tool. Then I will retrieve typical carbon chemical shift ranges with `retrieve_carbon_shifts` to identify which peaks correspond to aromatic carbons (generally ~110–160 ppm). By counting those peaks, I can provide the integer answer.</thought>
